about: A drift of fairy motes: nine soft points of cyan, magenta and green between 0.6 and 2.4 m over a 3 m patch, each a core in its halo. Their drift and breathing are runtime work (anchors Mote_k). Origin at the patch's ground centre.

acoustics.about: materials carry glTF extras {"acoustic": <preset|"none">}; large near-level meshes carry node extras {"acoustic": <preset>} (what the game reads); relief, trim, clutter and plants are left out
